question: How should one attend upon the sun during the interval with focused devotion?
premises: One should stand before the sun in the interval.
One should do so with an undivided mind directed to the speaker.
inference: During the interval one should attend upon the sun with an undivided mind focused on the speaker.
uncertainties: The exact sense of antaraṃ as time or space is not fully explicit.
plain_english: And in the interval one should stand before the sun, with an undivided mind fixed on me.
